messages:
morgan_dev: Need help. Our edge sample in the monorepo fails to bundle when it depends on @redwood/sdk via pnpm workspace: `Could not resolve "@redwood/sdk"`. Works if I run inside packages/sdk. Anyone seen this pattern?

sara_devex: Yup. Usually a restrictive exports map + pnpm symlink layout. Edge bundlers (esbuild on Vercel) sometimes don't resolve exports like Node.

kai_build: Paste SDK package.json exports? If it's only {"import": "./dist/index.mjs", "require": "./dist/index.cjs"} that can break tools that expect '.' or need package.json metadata.

morgan_dev: It's minimal: "exports": {"import":"./dist/index.mjs","require":"./dist/index.cjs"}, "types":"dist/index.d.ts".

olga_ts: Quick fixes: add "./package.json": "./package.json" to exports, add a dot export for '.' that provides an edge conditional (edge -> ./dist/edge.mjs, default -> ./dist/index.mjs), or add a wildcard "./*": "./dist/*". Also ensure `types` points to a root d.ts or include a root types proxy so TS can find declarations in workspaces.

sara_devex: Also watch side-effects: if auth/patch-fetch is only imported indirectly, bundler may drop it in edge builds. Either import it explicitly in `dist/edge.mjs` (`import './auth/patch-fetch.js'`) or mark it in package.json "sideEffects": ["./auth/patch-fetch.js"] so it's not tree-shaken.

kai_build: Short-term hack for local dev: add a tiny `index.mjs` at package root that re-exports dist (`export * from './dist/index.mjs'`) and include it in exports. Use a postinstall script to generate it if needed. Not ideal but catches editor/CI issues.

ci-bot: Suggested CI catch: add repo-root smoke job `pnpm --filter apps/edge build` to validate workspace resolution in PRs.

morgan_dev: Perfect checklist. I'll open a PR: add '.' export with edge conditional, expose package.json, add root proxy for a short period, and add CI smoke build. Will ping for review. Thanks!
